pathwayDetails.description: Candidates who complete the introductory modules qualify for merit evaluation into advanced specialisation tracks.

pathwayDetails.title: Advanced Diploma in Software Engineering (ADSE)
pathwayDetails.description: Top performers receive eligibility for full or partial scholarship slots into Aptech's flagship multi-semester ADSE programme.

pathwayDetails.title: Credit transfer for HND / B.Sc.
pathwayDetails.description: ADSE graduates can use Aptech's credit transfer tie-ups with overseas partner universities to complete a B.Sc. or HND in reduced time and cost.

eligibility.title: Who can apply?
eligibility.description: Open to Nigerian citizens, students, secondary school graduates, job seekers and working professionals seeking modern IT competencies.

eligibility.title: Application requirements
eligibility.description: A basic interest in technology. Candidates complete the online registration and select their preferred accredited Aptech centre.

eligibility.title: How to enrol
eligibility.description: Register online, pay the scholarship form fee, then sit the entrance assessment at your centre. Your form and exam date are issued once the fee is confirmed.
